subject: On-demand roundtable: registrant trial-bridge & promo code approval
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Promo pool request for BrightBridge on‑demand roundtable

Hey team,

Following up from the BrightBridge call last week — they want an on‑demand recording of the June 15 roundtable routed behind a short registration form. Their ask: a set of one‑time promo codes we can issue to registrants that (a) unlock a 21‑day trial (instead of the standard 7 days) and (b) include $10k in product credit to use in that window. BrightBridge will distribute to ~2500 registrants; they expect ~600 conversions in the first two weeks.

What we need from Redwood: approval to create the promo pool and confirmation of caps/expiry. Proposed parameters (marketing stub):
- Pool total: $10,000 in credits (equivalent billing unit attached)
- Per‑account cap: $500 credit max
- Trial extension: 21 days (trial bridge applied on first activation)
- Code type: single‑use, unique codes delivered via CSV (attached)
- Expiry: codes valid for 45 days after issue

Attachments: on‑demand‑promo_codes.csv (sample), promo‑banner.png for landing, and a short SLA note.

If ops/legal have concerns about unlimited activation or billing exposure, flag them here. If approved, I’ll upload the codes and share the HubSpot link for tracking.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Demand Gen
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo pool request for BrightBridge on‑demand roundtable

Marissa — thanks for the write‑up and the attachments. A couple quick questions before I can sign off:
1) Can ops confirm exposure if 600 activations each get $500 max? That’s potentially $300k exposure if we only cap at code level (I think you meant $500 per account but pool total locks the real limit).
2) Legal: anything in the SLA that we need to escalate? I see the PDF but haven’t read it yet.
3) Timeline: BrightBridge wants codes live by July 6 to coincide with an email drop. Can we make that?

Cc’ing Grace to give ops a quick feasibility read and Vivek for budget approval if we need to enlarge the pool.

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo pool request for BrightBridge on‑demand roundtable

Thanks — reviewed the ask and attachments. Operational notes and recommendation:

Summary of risk: the pool total caps exposure. If we issue unique single‑use codes pulled from the attached CSV and enforce pool depletion at issuance time, the maximum exposure is the $10k pool Marissa proposed. The per‑account cap should be enforced at activation to avoid a single account consuming many codes.

Our recommended parameters to minimize friction and risk:
- Pool total: $10,000 (as proposed) — we will configure pool depletion tracking at issuance time
- Per‑account cap: $600 credit max (slightly higher to keep partner happy)
- Trial extension: activate 21‑day trial on first activation only
- Code validity: 45 days from issuance
- Single‑use codes: yes — enforce via activation API call
Attachments: trial‑bridge‑sla.pdf (ops addendum) — includes rate‑limit guidance for on‑demand activation spikes and recommended throttling windows.

Timeline: We can turn codes live by July 5 if we get final approval today for the pool. I’ve also added a HubSpot UTM and tracking link we should use so BrightBridge conversions auto‑sync (see HubSpot link below).

HubSpot tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If legal wants to tighten expiry or require additional indemnities, let me know — otherwise ops is good to stand up the pool and monitor for spikes.

Best,
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Partner Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo pool request for BrightBridge on‑demand roundtable

Good work — I approve moving forward with the pool under the ops recommendations, with one adjustment: increase the total pool to $12,000 to account for higher than expected uplift and to keep BrightBridge engaged. Conditions:
- Pool total: $12,000 (one‑time promotional credit)
- Per‑account cap: $600 max (enforced at activation)
- Code expiry: 45 days after issue
- Trial: 21‑day trial bridge on first activation
- Marketing must use HubSpot tracking and include the UTM to ensure we can attribute usage to the campaign

Marissa — please confirm you’ve sent the final CSV to BrightBridge and include the DocuSign link below in the partner addendum. Ops, please proceed to create the pool and pre‑stage monitoring for the first 72 hours.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/contract/ABC-DEF-123

Once Marissa confirms, I’ll notify finance to record the promotional allowance against Q3 marketing credits.

Thanks,
Vivek
